screens.name: Hub menu and top bar (on Today)
screens.job: Move between FavorOS's areas, search, open reminders and help. Graded here once; the page body is graded as its own screen.

screens.name: Today
screens.job: See what is waiting on me today and open it.

screens.name: Work overview
screens.job: Pick a work tool and see how much is waiting in each.

screens.name: Work Center
screens.job: Work through my Blackbaud actions for partners: finish, reschedule, thank gifts, enter the week.

screens.name: Request board
screens.job: Review requests staff sent in and move each one along.

screens.name: Make a request
screens.job: Send a request to the tech team.

screens.name: Expense request
screens.job: Fill in and sign an expense request.

screens.name: Thank-you receipts
screens.job: Print the thank-you receipts Blackbaud has waiting and mark them done.

screens.name: Foundations
screens.job: Check whether a foundation is already in Blackbaud and log a contact with it.

screens.name: Meetings day
screens.job: See today's meetings, start one, join one.

screens.name: Book a meeting
screens.job: Book a meeting from everyone's calendars.

screens.name: Meeting notes
screens.job: Find a past meeting and read its notes, action items and transcript.

screens.name: Clips
screens.job: Find one of my recorded clips, play it, share it.

screens.name: Chat
screens.job: Read and send messages in channels and direct messages.

screens.name: Favor Brain
screens.job: Ask a question about partners, giving, team numbers or the manuals.

screens.name: Reports
screens.job: Run a report and export it.

screens.name: Admin overview
screens.job: Check the health of the Blackbaud copy and the morning jobs, and open a setting.

screens.name: People and roles
screens.job: See who can sign in and change a person's role, team and access.

screens.name: Admin settings
screens.job: Change a hub setting.

screens.name: Blackbaud users
screens.job: See everyone with a Blackbaud login, their status and what they can do.

screens.name: Audit log
screens.job: See who changed which setting and when.

screens.name: Expense log
screens.job: See every expense request, its status and its signed PDF.

screens.name: Help docs
screens.job: Find the article that explains a tool.

screens.name: Help videos
screens.job: Find and watch a training video.

screens.name: Feedback
screens.job: Read my feedback notes and the answers to them.

screens.name: Search (overlay)
screens.job: Jump to a page, a partner or a help article by typing.

screens.name: Help for this page (overlay, on Work Center)
screens.job: Read a short answer about the page I am on, or open its article.

screens.name: More sheet (phone)
screens.job: Reach the areas that do not fit in the tab bar.

screens.name: Reminders (bell)
screens.job: See my reminders and set how I am reminded.

screens.name: Request drawer
screens.job: Read one request in full and act on it.

screens.name: Huddle sheet (Chat)
screens.job: Check my camera and microphone, then join or start a huddle.

screens.name: Partner page
screens.job: See one partner's giving, contact details and my open actions with them, and act.

screens.name: Brain answer
screens.job: Read the answer to a question I asked.

screens.name: Chat channel (phone; on desktop the Chat screen already shows a channel)
screens.job: Read one channel and write a message in it.
